semiconductor_relevance: High — Bonotec specializes in high-end adhesive products specifically designed for advanced semiconductor packaging applications.
summary: Bonotec Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of chip-level adhesive products and solutions, focusing on high-performance materials for semiconductor packaging. With over 100 product lines, their offerings are utilized across various sectors including automotive and industrial electronics.

regional_presence.China: Bonotec is based in Shanghai and has established itself as a well-known brand of high-end adhesives in the Chinese market.
